stories.title: Carousel navigation model: wrap (skip gated) + auto-rotate + velocity swipe-pause
acceptance: #12 WRAP: swiping past the last visible card lands on the first and vice-versa; hidden/vehicle-gated cards are SKIPPED (wrap + auto-rotate traverse only visible cards) -- replaces the current clamp (carousel.js:36-48,143-150)
#13 AUTO-ROTATE: visible cards auto-cycle every autoRotateS (default 8 s) with a calm thin top progress bar (time-to-next, no countdown number)

#13 SWIPE-TO-PAUSE via a NEW velocity model (swipe is distance-only today): at pointer-up compute v=dx/dt; FAST if |v|>=0.6 px/ms OR travel>=~55% width -> advance + RESUME auto-rotate; SLOW/settle -> move one card + PAUSE; distance>=~40px still required to count as a swipe at all
tap on a card or opening any overlay PAUSES; auto-resume after resumeIdleS (default 45 s) of no interaction so it never freezes forever

all constants land in config under pi.display.carousel.* (autoRotateS/resumeIdleS/velocity threshold/distance thresholds); tests cover wrap-skips-gated + velocity slow-vs-fast + pause/resume; ruff clean

validationCriteria.action: on the Pi with a gated card hidden: swipe past the last visible card; leave it untouched; do a slow settle swipe then a fast flick
validationCriteria.outcome: wraps to first (gated card skipped); auto-cycles at the interval; slow swipe pauses, fast flick resumes; 45 s idle auto-resumes

stories.goal: As the operator, I want the carousel to wrap around, auto-cycle when I'm not touching it, and pause when I settle on a screen, so it's hands-off but never traps me or fights my swipe.

stories.title: Consolidate 6 cards to 4: merge Battery + Light + Fuel Trim into one 'Health' card
acceptance: merge the Battery Health + Light + LTFT cards into ONE 'Health' card (battery: verdict + cell V + checked-Nd-ago + runtime-to-cutoff, honest F-9 stale-green guard; light: TSL2591 lux + bright/dimmed state; fuel-trim: the former LTFT-Trend content)

retitle 'LTFT Trend' -> plain 'Fuel Trim' -- SEMANTICS UNCHANGED (Spool's LTFT meaning preserved); it stays vehicle-gated -> honest 'no engine data' on bench, never fabricated; Battery + Light stay available regardless
final carousel order: Home . System Status . Health . Alerts (drop the 2 now-merged standalone cards from the DOM/nav)
the merged card preserves every honest-instrument state of the three sources (insufficient/drift/gated/stale-green) -- relocation only, no new data or semantics
tests cover the merged card renders each sub-section's real state; the Fuel Trim gate still hides engine data on bench; ruff clean

validationCriteria.action: on the Pi (bench, engine off): swipe through the carousel and view the Health card
validationCriteria.outcome: 4 cards total (Home/System Status/Health/Alerts); Health shows real battery + light; Fuel Trim reads 'no engine data' (gated), not a fabricated value

stories.goal: As the operator, I want fewer screens -- Home, System Status, Health, Alerts -- so the reference readouts that share a glance live on one card instead of three separate swipes.

stories.title: Live/motion card re-issue to locked spec + home-slot idle-live swap
acceptance: re-issue the live card to the CIO-locked spec (2026-07-27-pi-live-instrument-card.md): scrolling compass TAPE under a fixed caret (NOT the built rotating-needle dial); add the GEAR glyph (Spool OBD derivation, '--' when ambiguous); AMBER at 0.6 g (not just the 1.0 g full-scale clamp); grade % + prominent altitude + ~15-min moving trend
HOME-SLOT SWAP: the home slot (position 1) shows the idle card when parked and the live instrument when driving -- one slot, two faces (not a separate always-present card)
honest fallback: stale/absent states/imu -> idle card, never a frozen motion display (states/imu is live @0x69)

[ATLAS CONTRACT RULED 2026-07-31 -- UNGATED] states/imu is the DERIVED display view produced by the ONE dedicated reader/bridge (single owner, DELTA-2); the display is a PURE consumer (never opens bus/I2C, never fuses). Fields: headingDeg 0-359 from mag TILT-COMPENSATED via accel (flag as known-limit if v1 non-compensated -- the READER owns this, not the display); gradePct=tan(pitch)*100; gLat/gLon = tilt-compensated horizontal accel in UNITS OF g; gMag=sqrt(gLat^2+gLon^2) derived-once (don't recompute in the g-circle); altitude = typed-NULL + reason:'no_source' (NO GPS/baro source today -- honest-NA, never fabricated/zeroed; field stays for zero-rework later); available(bool)+ts(fresh) -> stale ts falls to the idle twin. GEAR is NOT imu (Spool OBD derivation, separate producer -- keep it out of states/imu). Raw accel/gyro/mag/temp_c stay on the EDR bus + sensor_schema.py, NOT states/imu

[ATLAS TRANSPORT RULED] the states/imu bridge writes the derived file at ~10-15 Hz latest-wins/lossy (no history on the display path; durable EDR persist stays at the ADR persistHz -- one producer, two cadences); the live card polls states/imu at ~10 Hz off the existing states_http_server (localhost, no-store). Animates the tape+g-trail smoothly with NO new transport. A full SSE/stream is the future EDR-bus target, NOT required here -- do not block on it
tests cover tape/gear/0.6g-amber render + idle<->live swap + stale-IMU fallback; ruff clean

validationCriteria.action: on the Pi: view the home card parked, then with live states/imu motion; move the board past 0.6 g
validationCriteria.outcome: parked shows idle; driving shows compass tape + gear + grade + altitude; amber engages at 0.6 g; stale IMU falls back to idle (never frozen)

conditionalOutcomes: if Atlas's contract ruling changes the derived-field shape, the card binds to the ruled contract
stories.goal: As the driver, I want the home card to become the live instrument when I'm driving (and the calm idle card when parked), matching the design I approved, so the at-a-glance card shows real motion.

stories.title: System-Status 'N ISSUE' drill-down overlay
acceptance: make the SYSTEM summary line tappable -> a drill-down overlay listing the degraded source(s) WORST-FIRST: each row = source label + state chip (amber/red) + honest reason + freshness ('seen Ns ago'); one row per non-OK source
a '<- Back' returns to the card (never traps); opening the overlay pauses auto-rotate (interaction)
honest-instrument: only actually-degraded sources appear (green sources never listed); mirror the DTC detail overlay pattern so the interaction language is consistent
no change to how source states are computed -- reads the existing per-tile levels; tests cover worst-first ordering + back + green-never-listed; ruff clean

validationCriteria.action: with one source degraded, tap the SYSTEM summary line; then with all sources good
validationCriteria.outcome: opens a worst-first list of only the degraded source(s) with reason + freshness + Back; when all good, the summary is not a misleading tap target

stories.goal: As the operator, I want to tap 'SYSTEM · N ISSUE' and see which sources are degraded and why, so the summary isn't a dead end.

stories.title: Fidelity pass: restore approved copy + brand display face + TD-065 tokenization
acceptance: A-1 copy (ship-ahead, no gate): restore idle wordmark 'ECLIPSE' -> 'ECLIPSE OBD-II' and footer -> 'swipe for details . hold or the kebab for setup' (verbatim from the locked idle spec)

A-3 brand face (ship-ahead): add ONE --font-display face (inlined @font-face woff2 data-URI, CSP-safe -- NO font CDN) for the wordmark + card titles ONLY; keep ui-monospace for all data/values; add --font-display to specs/UI/tokens.css alongside --font-mono. Exact face is a CIO pick (Iris supplies the woff2 base64)

A-2 tokenization (TD-065): point the dashboard at existing tokens where they exist (#2a2f37 -> --neutral-chip-bg tokens.css:44; --critical-red #D32F2F already landed); derive takeover-gradient edges from --green-ok/--amber-warn (no raw hex in a surface)

[ATLAS TOKENS RULED 2026-07-31 -- UNGATED] promote --bg: #000000 + --surface: #111111 into specs/UI/tokens.css (SSOT) + repoint dashboard.css to var(--bg)/var(--surface) -- PURE consolidation, the values ARE the current ones so ZERO visual change (a diff that changes rendered pixels FAILS the gate). Define --destructive: #C62828 (destructive-action fill) + --destructive-border: #7F1D1D (confirm-box border); BOTH MUST be distinct from --critical-red #D32F2F (a destructive ACTION must not read as an alarm STATE -- that conflation is exactly what the split prevents). Iris applies which-surface-uses-which; reds are UI-affordance not safety, so Spool ratify optional/non-blocking
acceptance: no raw color hex in dashboard.css outside :root token defs (for the ungated literals); --font-display renders the wordmark/titles; ruff clean

validationCriteria.action: on the Pi: read the idle wordmark + footer; inspect dashboard.css for raw hex outside :root
validationCriteria.outcome: wordmark 'ECLIPSE OBD-II' + correct footer in a brand display face; ungated color literals tokenized; Atlas-gated --bg/--surface/--destructive land once ruled

conditionalOutcomes: if Atlas has not ruled the --bg/--surface/--destructive values by build time, ship the ungated fidelity (copy+font+existing tokens) and carry the gated literals to a fast-follow rather than block the whole story
stories.goal: As the CIO, I want the shipped UI to match the look & feel I approved, so it stops feeling generic -- correct wordmark/footer, a brand display face for brand moments, and no raw color literals.

stories.title: Debounced 'parked' signal for the kebab (stop the OBD-blip flicker)
acceptance: define a debounced 'parked' signal: parked = idle held true for >= parkedOnS (8 s), reverting only after idle false for >= parkedOffS (3 s) -- hysteresis so brief OBD blips don't flip it
the context-aware kebab (Option C) keys off 'parked', NOT raw system-status.idle (carousel.js:743-748,876-878)

NEAR-TERM = display-side debounce of the idle it already consumes -- NO new contract (Iris's recommendation). If instead 'parked' becomes an emitter field, that needs an Atlas nod (same class as the open idle-SSOT question) -- default to display-debounce now
constants (parkedOnS/parkedOffS) in config; test proves a sub-threshold idle blip does not toggle the kebab; ruff clean

validationCriteria.action: on the Pi parked, induce a brief OBD-availability blip
validationCriteria.outcome: the kebab stays put through the blip (no flicker); it shows/hides only on a sustained parked/driving transition; long-press still always works

stories.goal: As the operator, I want the kebab to appear on a steady 'parked' concept, so it stops flickering every time OBD availability blips.
